title: ContextSafe deterministic unsigned compiled mapping profile v1
description: What `contextsafe mapping validate` emits: the canonical form of one mapping profile (rows sorted by source, review fixed to not_reviewed) and its SHA-256, which is the digest every observation an import records when the profile is applied. Unsigned and non-executable by construction: `contextsafe mapping sign` does not exist, no signer key or trust manifest is enrolled, and the constants below cannot be relabelled by a later signing layer. A document that validates has proved shape only, not that its digest still matches its profile.

profile.$comment: The canonical profile, a document valid under contextsafe-mapping-profile-v1.schema.json. Nested rather than referenced by $ref across files, because nothing here resolves a URI.
